summary: Micropolis AI Robotics, a Dubai-based NYSE American-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a September 29, 2026 NYSE Regulation notice of noncompliance with Section 1003(a)(ii) of the NYSE American Company Guide. Stockholders' equity was $2.2 million as of June 30, 2025 versus the $4.0 million minimum required after net losses in three of four recent fiscal years. The company must submit a compliance plan by October 29, 2026, targeting regained compliance by March 29, 2028; failure risks delisting proceedings. No price or board recommendation stated. Watch plan acceptance and financing risk.
